consensus.enumeration_note: The video teaches one promoted strategy: a long support-bounce scalp sold into resistance/quick upside. A later short-after-support-break move is mentioned with an entry, but its exit is only gestural ('you want to exit right there'), so under Rule 1 it remains an unpromoted mention, not a second strategy object.

phase_a_scope.name: support_to_resistance_scalp

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: in today's example I'm going to show you how to scalp using the F minute chart
entry_sequence.action: Use the 5-minute chart for this scalping setup.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker frames the example on the 5-minute chart.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: what you want to do is time your entries once you have allowed the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass
entry_sequence.action: Wait for the first 5 to 15 minutes after the open before taking an entry.
entry_sequence.rationale: This delay helps establish the key level first.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: it allows you to establish where support is at
entry_sequence.action: Identify the support area before entry; for long, use established support below price, and for short, use the mirrored resistance area above price.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup depends on a recognized reaction level.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: this 13 EMA operated as a initial support
entry_sequence.action: For long entries, use the 13 EMA as support when price pulls back and reacts there; if trading the mirrored short version, use the failed support/resistance flip as the opposite-side trigger.
entry_sequence.rationale: The 13 EMA is taught as the first intraday support reference.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the stock came down and it hit right there that's our entry for a scalp
entry_sequence.action: Enter when price comes into the identified support area and bounces; for the mirrored short version, enter when price rallies into resistance and rejects.
entry_sequence.rationale: The entry is taken on the reaction off the level.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: another quick Scout this one off a deeper support sitting at the 200 EMA once the 13 EMA gave up its support status
entry_sequence.action: If the 13 EMA no longer holds, look for a deeper support entry at the 200 EMA; for the mirrored short version, use the opposite-side deeper resistance/failure context.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker teaches the 200 EMA as the next support reference when the 13 EMA fails.

targets.transcript_quote: you ride it to resistance and you exit
targets.rationale: Primary target is resistance on the scalp.

targets.transcript_quote: you get in and out you don't overstay your welcome
targets.rationale: The management objective is a fast scalp rather than a prolonged hold.
